entities.name: Sonogashira coupling
observations: The encoded reaction contains a terminal alkyne fragment and an aryl/heteroaryl bromide scaffold.
CuI plus a palladium phosphine catalyst and amine/base additives support a Sonogashira cross-coupling.
The expected product replaces the scaffold C–Br bond with a scaffold C–C≡C–alkyl bond.

entities.name: Terminal heptyne fragment
observations: The first encoded component contains a terminal C#C motif followed by an alkyl chain; it is interpreted as a terminal alkyne coupling partner.
The exact conventional SMILES cannot be recovered confidently from the nonstandard Ring/Branch encoding alone.

entities.name: Bromo heteroaryl scaffold
observations: The second encoded component contains one explicit Br atom at the prospective coupling position and multiple heteroatoms, carbonyls, sulfur, nitrogen, fluorine, and an internal alkyne/ring system.
The exact conventional scaffold SMILES cannot be recovered confidently from the nonstandard encoding alone.
